mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_sorting_scale_event (event_key, task_id, task_item_id, sku_id, device_code, raw_reading, unit, stable_flag, captured_at, received_at, status, version) VALUES (#{row.eventKey}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.taskItemId}, #{row.skuId}, #{row.deviceCode}, #{row.rawReading}, #{row.unit}, #{row.stableFlag}, #{row.capturedAt}, #{row.receivedAt}, 'PENDING', 0) ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM xsy_sorting_scale_event WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_sorting_scale_event SET status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_quantity = #{acceptedQuantity}, accepted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, accepted_by = #{operator}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}

UPDATE xsy_sorting_scale_event SET status = 'REJECTED', rejected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, rejected_by = #{operator}, reject_reason = #{reason}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}
